source.scope: Ephemeral Arena Linux workspace VM/container; not a physical product machine or a statement about other runners.

inventory.command: python3 -m pip install --target /tmp/arena-hardware-profile-deps psutil==7.2.2; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/arena-hardware-profile-deps python3 tools/measure_hardware_profile.py --out output/local-hardware-inventory.json
inventory.temporary_dependency: psutil 7.2.2 installed outside the repository solely to obtain RAM measurements; Torch/model dependencies were not installed.

accelerator_access.scope_note: No accelerator was exposed to this workspace. This does not prove that a physical host or a separate CI runner has no GPU.

model_asset_search.repository_search: No .pt, .pth, .onnx, .safetensors or .bin model files found by the workspace search (max depth 5).
model_asset_search.silero_package_search: No v3_1_ru.pt or v4_ru.pt found under /home/user (max depth 4).

inference_attempt.outcome: The smoke script stopped before model loading, download, inference, audio generation or timing/RSS measurements.

limitations: The available VM CPU and RAM inventory is not an inference benchmark or a supported product profile.
No wall-time, process RSS, VRAM, model output or full-render result was measured because the smoke attempt failed before importing Torch.
The workspace's lack of exposed GPU devices is local to this ephemeral environment and does not establish whether a GPU runner is available elsewhere.
Previously recorded Windows CPU Silero speech results remain narrow speech measurements; they do not establish a full-song profile, CUDA/ROCm support or quality acceptance.
